facts.fact: In the 2017/18 school year, teams from the ministry and the NGO FEC collected learner, teacher and class records school by school in Gabu region and keyed them into the pilot platform at a regional hub, with ministry statisticians to monitor each school term; the document describes no entry by the schools themselves.
facts.system: Firkidja di Skola (Sistema Piloto de Informação de Gestão da Educação)

facts.fact: The system is described as a pilot covering the basic and secondary schools of Gabu region active in 2017/18, with no figure for schools in the country and a hope that it will be extended to the whole territory.
facts.system: Firkidja di Skola (Sistema Piloto de Informação de Gestão da Educação)

facts.fact: The pilot covers basic and secondary education schools of Gabu region in 2017/18.
facts.system: Firkidja di Skola (Sistema Piloto de Informação de Gestão da Educação)

facts.fact: The pilot is developed by the Gabu regional government and the NGO FEC with ministry units (GEPASE, the inspectorate, the regional directorate), and the platform was built by a consortium of the CPLP training institute and Codevision.
facts.system: Firkidja di Skola (Sistema Piloto de Informação de Gestão da Educação)

facts.fact: The pilot is financed by the European Union.
